summary: End-to-end backend + frontend validation of iter-69 scope (storefront signup/login/PIN lockout, referral, profile+address modals, addresses page, checkout prefill, rider topbar + /rider/messages, customer notifications page, push subscribe). Backend pytest: 19/19 PASS covering POST /api/public/customer-signup (weak PIN 123456 -> 400 'simple', short PIN -> 400, invalid referral code -> 400, duplicate phone -> 409, valid signup returns {token, customer} with access_code=pin and wallet=0), POST /api/public/customer-login-code (5 wrong codes -> 401 each, 6th -> 429, correct code -> 200 session), referral at signup increments filleul.wallet by referral_bonus_filleul and marraine.wallet by referral_bonus_parrain + referral_count+1, POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/public/account/addresses (first add auto-defaults, patching default:true flips, delete removes), POST /api/public/account/push/subscribe + /api/push/subscribe accept {subscription:{endpoint,keys:{p256dh,auth}}} (400 on empty), GET /api/me/notifications returns {items,unread} and /read zeroes unread, GET /api/rider/conversations lists participant threads and rider2 gets 404 on rider1 conv (both GET detail and POST send). Frontend (Chromium 1366x900 + 375x844): (1) Storefront unauth -> [data-testid=storefront-account] click reveals [data-testid=guest-dropdown] with guest-login + guest-signup links; (2) /boutique/compte?mode=inscription renders [data-testid=signup-form]; weak PIN 123456 + mismatched PIN both rejected with inline/toast error; valid signup with +225 07 1X XX XX XX auto-logs in -> [data-testid=account-shell] visible; (3) Overview [data-testid=card-info-edit] opens [data-testid=edit-modal] containing edit-name/email/birthday/shoe/clothing and ZERO addr-* fields (verified via DOM query); saving does not navigate to /console; (4) [data-testid=card-address-add] opens [data-testid=address-modal] with addr-label-* chips, addr-locate (GPS), addr-zone <select> (Cocody/Riviera/Angré/Plateau/Marcory...), addr-quartier, addr-rue, addr-reperes, addr-default, addr-save — save persists and stays on /boutique/compte; (5) /boutique/compte/adresses renders [data-testid=addresses]; addr-edit-{id} rendered per address, addr-make-default-{id} rendered only for non-default items (code-reviewed line 825 AccountShell.jsx), addr-delete-{id} present; (6) /boutique/checkout logged-in: [data-testid=checkout-customer-card] visible, name/phone inputs absent, [data-testid=checkout-address-chooser] with 2 checkout-addr-{id} radios + checkout-addr-new present; (7) /boutique/compte/notifications shows push-enable button; (8) Rider1 login (btn 'Démarrer ma journée') lands on /rider — topbar has [data-testid=rider-messages-btn] and [data-testid=rider-notif-btn]; clicking notif opens [data-testid=rider-notif-panel] listing 'Nouvelle course', 'Course DN-… modifiée · en route', and 'Message de TEST_Cliente Auto' with [data-testid=rider-push-enable] inside; (9) /rider/messages renders [data-testid=rider-inbox] with 7 rider-conv-{id} items (customer + boutique conversations); opening first conv shows [data-testid=rider-conversation] + rider-msg-input + rider-msg-send; (10) 375px horizontal overflow = 0 on /boutique/compte, /boutique/compte/adresses, /boutique/compte/notifications, /boutique/checkout, /rider, /rider/messages.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py cust_signup correctly stores access_code=pin and only credits wallets when marraine is found; referral_count is $inc on marraine. Weak-PIN list is adequate (123456/654321/000000-999999/121212). WEAK_PIN check uses equality so '112233' is NOT rejected — add a repetition / sequence check if business wants stricter policy.
notify.py _save_sub validates endpoint + p256dh key; upserts by endpoint which prevents duplicate subs per browser. _push_to runs in asyncio.to_thread with 404/410 cleanup — good.

messagerie.py rider_conversations/{cid} and /send both filter by {participants.id: user['id']} so rider2 correctly gets 404 on rider1 convs. _after_order_msg routes rider_customer -> notify(customer) with link /boutique/compte/messages/{conv.id} — correct deep link.

server.py account_addresses_add: when body.default=True or list empty, resets other default flags and sets body.default=True. OK. account_addresses_update honors body.default by flipping all others — OK. No validation on zone/quartier required fields (frontend enforces via AddressForm select). Minor: no max addresses cap (consider 20).
AccountShell.jsx Addresses(): address-new button always rendered at top; addr-make-default-{id} only when !a.default; addr-edit/-delete per row — matches test contract.
StorefrontLayout.jsx guest-dropdown exposes guest-login + guest-signup (?mode=inscription) — matches request.
Checkout logged-in path hides checkout-name/phone inputs (verified in DOM) and surfaces checkout-customer-card + checkout-address-chooser with checkout-addr-{id} + checkout-addr-new as expected.
